_comment: Batch 2 (stage 23). One entry per mod: how it is carried and what is pruned. 'licence' is the Modrinth/jar metadata, not legal advice. 'publicRelease': false means the packed .hmod must never go into a public release archive. All numbers added by tools/batch2_content.py are estimates (see docs/batch2.md).

mods.name: Ocean's Delight
mods.notes: Farmer's Delight seafood addon. Cooking and cutting recipes are consumed by the native Farmer's Delight pot and board (any namespace). Adds estimated food components and a feast shell for guardian_soup (interactive serving and entity loot injection on squid/guardian/elder_guardian are not ported).

mods.name: Crate Delight
mods.notes: 30 storage crates and bags for vanilla, Farmer's Delight and Expanded Delight items. Recipes for absent mods or failing fabric:load_conditions are pruned together with their uncraftable crates.

mods.name: Obsidian Equipment Reworked
mods.notes: Obsidian armor, tools, horse/nautilus armor, spear, ingot and smithing template. Adds estimated armor/tool stats and equippable slots. Drops vanilla netherite smithing overrides so vanilla progression stays intact when template loot is absent.

mods.name: Minecraft Accelerated
mods.notes: 28 decorative carved pumpkins, jack o'lanterns and soul jack o'lanterns with crafting recipes and self-drop loot tables. Sets light=15 on jack_o_lantern_* and light=10 on soul_jack_o_lantern_*.

mods.name: Create Deco
mods.notes: Industrial Create decoration blocks, items and recipes (including stonecutting and create:pressing). Kept local-only (publicRelease: false) until the upstream fabric.mod.json placeholder is resolved. Interactive block behaviours beyond template matches are shells only.

mods.name: Sooty Chimneys
mods.notes: 14 decorative clean/dirty chimney blocks and crafting recipes. Drops soot_scraping recipes; smoke particles and soot accumulation/scraping require client particle and block-entity hooks and are not ported.
